mapper.select: SELECT b.course_id AS bookmark_course_id,b.create_time AS saved_at, c.id,c.title,c.description,c.difficulty,c.estimated_minutes,c.language_code, c.mentor_id,u.nick_name AS mentor_name,c.status,1 AS bookmarked FROM learning_bookmark b LEFT JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=b.course_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e WHERE e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.active=1) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.mentor_id WHERE b.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY b.create_time DESC,b.course_id DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_bookmark WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND course_id=#{courseId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_bookmark(student_id,course_id) VALUES(#{studentId},#{courseId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE course_id=VALUES(course_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM learning_bookmark WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND course_id=#{courseId}
